scripts.build: npm run types:generate && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:admin: if python3 -c "import sqlite3; sqlite3.connect(':memory:').close()" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'; else PYSQLITE_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/atrinik-pysqlite.XXXXXX) && python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --target "$PYSQLITE_DIR" -r scripts/requirements/sqlite.txt && PYTHONPATH="$PYSQLITE_DIR${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'; fi
scripts.check: npm run types:generate && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:admin && npm run test:deployment && npm run deploy:dry-run && npm run test:service-bindings && npm run test:maintenance && npm run deploy:production:validate
scripts.test:deployment: node --test scripts/test_production_read_pacing.mjs scripts/test_production_delivery.mjs scripts/test_production_promotion.mjs scripts/test_development_actions_authority.mjs scripts/test_delivery_resource_policy.mjs scripts/test_production_caller_retirement.mjs scripts/test_production_recovery_artifacts.mjs && node --test scripts/release/test-publish-complete-release.mjs
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run deploy:dry-run:core && npm run deploy:dry-run:publisher && npm run deploy:dry-run:rendezvous
scripts.types:generate: wrangler types worker-runtime.d.ts --include-env=false -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types publisher-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface PublisherEnv --include-runtime=false -c wrangler.publisher.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types rendezvous-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface RendezvousEnv --include-runtime=false -c wrangler.rendezvous.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.types:check: wrangler types worker-runtime.d.ts --include-env=false --check -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --check -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types publisher-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface PublisherEnv --include-runtime=false --check -c wrangler.publisher.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types rendezvous-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface RendezvousEnv --include-runtime=false --check -c wrangler.rendezvous.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.publisher.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.rendezvous.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.test:maintenance: node --test development/maintenance.test.mjs development/runtime.test.mjs && vitest run --config development/vitest.config.ts && tsc -p development/tsconfig.json
